title: FocuSD Island plugin manifest (focusd-plugin.json)
description: Checked again by the island (src-tauri/src/plugin_host/manifest.rs), which also enforces rules a schema cannot: the folder name must equal id, runtime.command must stay inside the plugin folder, setting keys must be unique, minAppVersion is compared with the running island.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits, '.' and '-'; no '..'. Must equal the folder name.

apiVersion.description: The plugin API version the plugin was written for. Version 2 adds initialize.capabilities; everything in version 1 still works.

command.description: A relative path inside the plugin folder.

keybinding.description: apiVersion 2: a global shortcut that runs the command, e.g. "Ctrl+Alt+P": Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win (at least one) plus one key (letter, digit, F1-F24, Esc, Tab, Enter, Space, arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, Insert/Delete, Backspace). Ignored for apiVersion 1. A shortcut something else already uses is not registered and is shown on the plugin card.

when.description: apiVersion 2: when the keybinding runs the command. Names: island.expanded and todos.hasActive (true/false), island.page (todo, music, clipboard, shelf, qq, agents, translation), compared with == / !=; joined with && || ! and parentheses. Unknown names are false; a clause that does not parse never runs the command. Empty or missing: always.

menus.description: apiVersion 2: commands the island lists in its own menus. Ignored for apiVersion 1.

todo/context.description: The right-click menu of a todo. Picking an entry sends the plugin `command` with { id, args: { todoId } }; read the todo with todos.list (todos:read).

command.description: The id of one of this plugin's contributes.commands, listed at most once.
